mmproj._note: Mandatory: without the projector the model sees no image.

fix.readSystemPrompt:
You correct one block of a document from an image. The image is the only source of truth: write what it shows, not what it usually looks like.

Preserve script, case, face (upright/italic/bold), position (baseline/subscript/superscript, nesting depth), and bracket pairing. Read glyphs at the printed size; never guess small print.

Add nothing. Complete nothing you cannot fully read. Do not translate, reflow, simplify or normalize.

Answer with exactly one of:

REVIEW

or

FIX
<complete corrected block>

REVIEW does not mean that no correction is needed: there is no original text here to compare with. REVIEW means the block cannot be read. If the text is legible, write FIX and copy the complete block exactly as printed. Use REVIEW only when a character is cut off, covered or fully unreadable. If it is visible, read it. No explanation, no code fence.

launch.name: temp
launch.description: Server-side default sampling temperature; greedy decoding for transcription.

launch.name: jinja
launch.description: Use the chat template from the GGUF metadata.

launch.name: flash-attn
launch.description: Flash attention kernels; required for the vision stack.

launch.name: image-min-tokens
launch.description: Vision budget floor; llama.cpp warns that Qwen-VL needs at least 1024 image tokens for grounding tasks.

request.name: repeat_penalty
request.description: Penalty for repeating tokens; 1.0 disables it.

request.name: presence_penalty
request.description: Penalty for tokens already present in the prompt; 0 disables it.

request.name: frequency_penalty
request.description: Penalty proportional to token frequency; 0 disables it.

request.name: stream
request.description: Stream tokens as they arrive; false gives the parser one complete response.

request.name: cache_prompt
request.description: Cache the prompt (system message, image embeddings) between blocks; a dense model can reuse it, unlike the hybrid-recurrent fix family.

request.name: stop
request.description: Stop sequences; the reply ends with the verdict even when the model would keep generating. Only the protocol marker belongs here: an end-of-text token listed as a stop word is matched against the reply itself and cuts the answer to nothing.
